act1.text: Classical NLP relied on recurrent networks, squeezing context into a fixed hidden vector. Distant words decayed, and sequential processing blocked parallelism.

act2.text: Attention shattered this bottleneck through direct random-access routing. Every token can now examine all other tokens across the sequence simultaneously.

act3.text: To route context intelligently, tokens project into three roles: Query seeking clues, Key advertising identity, and Value carrying the semantic payload.

act4.text: Queries take scaled dot-products with all Keys. Softmax normalizes these into attention weights, routing eighty-eight percent of the animal into the pronoun.

act5.text: Multi-head attention captures syntax and reference in parallel. Wrapped in residual connections, this Transformer block powers all modern foundation models.
